business.name: TPCDS 248 商品1年度销售汇总验收
business.description: 限定商品ss_item_sk=1，按实际销售日期年度汇总销售行数、数量、净收款和利润，排除无日期维度关联记录；无参数。

operation.statement:
SELECT
    d.d_year                                            AS sales_year,
    COUNT(*)                                            AS sales_rows,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity)                                 AS total_quantity,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)                                 AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)                               AS total_net_profit,
    MIN(d.d_date)                                       AS earliest_date,
    MAX(d.d_date)                                       AS latest_date
FROM store_sales  ss
INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = 1          
GROUP BY d.d_year
ORDER BY sales_year ASC
LIMIT 10

business.name: TPCDS 248 单品期间月度销售分析验收
business.description: 指定商品、起止日期、最低购买数量及可选品类的真实门店逐月销售、数量、净收款及利润，默认商品1，NULL品类不过滤。

operation.statement:
SELECT
    d.d_year                           AS sale_year,
    d.d_moy                            AS sale_month,
    i.i_category                       AS category,
    COUNT(*)                           AS row_count,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity)                AS total_quantity,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)                AS total_net_paid,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)              AS total_net_profit
FROM tpcds.store_sales ss
INNER JOIN tpcds.date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN tpcds.item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = 1
  AND d.d_date >= '1999-01-01'
  AND d.d_date <= '1999-12-31'
  AND ss.ss_quantity >= 0
  AND (NULL IS NULL OR i.i_category = NULL)
GROUP BY d.d_year,
         d.d_moy,
         i.i_category
ORDER BY d.d_year ASC,
         d.d_moy ASC,
         i.i_category ASC
LIMIT 24
